title: Conditional Release Sequence
prompt:
Build a conditional release plan. Common tasks A-H must be assigned to exactly six ordered nonempty stages, with at most three tasks per common stage.

Common task labels: A Build Candidate; B Prepare Rollback Bundle; C Prepare Release Record; D Validate Candidate; E Verify Rollback Bundle; F Authorize Pilot; G Deploy Pilot; H Assess Pilot.
Common prerequisites: A before D; B before E; C before F; D before F; E before F; F before G; G before H.

After H:
- PASS branch: I Deploy Full Release, then J Verify Full Release, then terminal state COMPLETE. K and L must not execute.
- FAIL branch: K Roll Back Pilot, then L Verify Rollback, then terminal state ROLLED_BACK. I and J must not execute.
- Only COMPLETE is successful release completion; ROLLED_BACK is not successful release completion.

Return one JSON object with this shape:
{"result":{"common_stages":[["A","B","C"],["D"],["E"],["F"],["G"],["H"]],"pass_branch":["I","J"],"pass_terminal":"COMPLETE","fail_branch":["K","L"],"fail_terminal":"ROLLED_BACK","successful_branch":"PASS"}}
Any valid six-stage common plan is accepted.
